Sampler diagnostics

Source: R/fit.R
bpk_diagnostics.Rd

Sampler diagnostics

Usage

bpk_diagnostics(x)

Arguments

x

A bpk_fit.

Value

A list with the number of divergent transitions, iterations at the maximum tree depth, E-BFMI per chain, maximum R-hat and minimum bulk and tail effective sample sizes of the population parameters.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("nlmixr2data", quietly = TRUE)) {
d <- nlmixr2data::theo_sd
mod <- pk_model("1cmt", route = "oral", iiv = c("CL", "V", "KA"))
fit <- bpk_fit(mod, d, chains = 2, iter = 1000, seed = 1)
bpk_diagnostics(fit)
}
